title: Why Homeowners Skip Any Shop Under 4 Stars
h1: Why Homeowners Skip Any Shop Under 4 Stars
meta: The vast majority of consumers won't consider a business under 4 stars (BrightLocal 2026). Your star rating is a filter before anyone ever calls.
short: Star rating is a gate. Most consumers won't even consider a business rated under 4 stars (BrightLocal 2026) — so a mediocre rating quietly deletes you from the list before the phone ever rings.
statLabel: The rating below which most homeowners won't even consider you (BrightLocal 2026)

body.answer: Below 4 stars, most homeowners never even call.
body.html: People don't read every review — they scan the number. The clear majority of consumers won't consider a business rated under 4 stars (BrightLocal 2026). So your rating isn't a trophy on the shelf; it's a bouncer at the door deciding who gets to pitch.

body.h2: Recent and steady beats a big old pile
body.answer: Homeowners weigh fresh reviews far more than old ones.
body.html: A wall of five-star reviews from three years ago reads as 'used to be good.' A steady trickle of recent ones reads as 'busy and trusted right now.' That's why the goal is a habit, not a one-time blast — a few every week, forever.

body.h2: The fix is a system, not a hope
body.answer: Ask every happy customer, every time, with one tap.
body.html: You don't need a gimmick. You need to ask every satisfied customer at the peak moment — job done, customer thrilled — with a one-tap link sent within the hour. Do that on every job and the rating takes care of itself.

body.answer: This one came straight off the podcast.
body.html: Marshall and Ray went deep on this in Get More Google Reviews on Get Booked, Not F***ed — same math, more cussing. Watch or listen to the full episode here.

faq.q: What Google rating do I need?
faq.a: Aim for 4.5+ and keep it recent. Most consumers won't consider a business rated under 4 stars (BrightLocal 2026), so anything below 4 is costing you calls.
Some, but homeowners weight recent reviews much more heavily. A steady flow of fresh reviews signals you're busy and trusted now.

faq.q: How do I raise my rating fast?
faq.a: Ask every happy customer at the moment the job's done, with a one-tap review link sent within the hour. Consistency beats any single push.
